definitions.explanation: An abbreviation for Saturday (土曜日) and Sunday (日曜日), used to refer to the weekend.

examples.japanese: {土日|どにち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧です。
examples.english: Saturday and Sunday are days off.

examples.japanese: {土日|どにち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいる→混む：02574_komu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: It's always crowded on weekends, so let's go on a weekday.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{土日|どにち}{祝日|しゅくじつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧でなくて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}できる→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: This shop is open on weekends and holidays too, so you can visit even if it's not after work.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common abbreviation in everyday Japanese. Often seen on signs, schedules, and in conversation. Frequently combined with ⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧ (national holidays) as {土日祝|どにちしゅく} or {土日|どにち}{祝日|しゅくじつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土日|どにち}⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧: weekends off
- {土日|どにち}{祝日|しゅくじつ}: weekends and holidays
- {土日|どにち}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧: open on weekends too
- {土日|どにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work on weekends

SIMILAR WORDS:
{土日|どにち} specifically means Saturday and Sunday. ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧ (weekend) is slightly more general and can sometimes include Friday evening. ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧ (day off, holiday) refers to any non-working day.
